facts.text: Chile lies between the Andes and the Pacific Ocean.
Chile borders Peru, Bolivia, and Argentina.

culture.text: Northern festivals such as La Tirana bring together Andean Indigenous and Spanish religious influences.

food.name: Curanto
food.text: Associated with Chiloé, this meal combines seafood, meat, and potatoes, traditionally cooked in an earth pit.
